author: nottherealtar
install_msg: `[p]sticky set Remember to grab a coffee` in a channel. Tune with `sticky threshold 3`. Help: `[p]sticky`.
name: sticky
short: Sticky channel messages that stay near the bottom
description: MEE6-style sticky messages: set text per channel, bot reposts after N messages so the note stays near the bottom.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-channel sticky text, last sticky message id, message counter, and threshold. No user profile data.
